page.overview:
What is Gideon's light cruiser?

The Arquitens-class command cruiser was the mobile headquarters of the moff,

The light cruiser first appeared in "Chapter 12: The Siege," an episode of the live-action TV show Star Wars: The Mandalorian, which aired in 2020.
